entries.2ca175d74e2c6e4c: Under the name “EBISU GROWTH,” this business provides integrated support from the EC strategy phase through to operations, regardless of whether the channel is the company's own EC site, a mall or cross-border. It is provided mainly through EC strategy PM support services and EC mall-specialized operation support services, and it has also begun offering the AI-enabled EC operations outsourcing service “EBISU AGENT.” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥129 million.
entries.3ec314e39f8db319: This service provides existing customers with introductions to various services of partner companies (such as display advertising services, product recommendation functions and various analytics functions) and advertising placements on the company's media. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥23 million.
entries.bc6a662052fc448c: A company supporting EC businesses from site construction and operation to growth support and data utilization, centered on the cloud commerce platform "EBISUMART."
entries.d47274f2286d5c05: This is a stock-type service that, after a customer's store opens on the cloud commerce platform, provides maintenance by EC concierges and consulting by a support team, among other services. The monthly usage fee consists of a basic fee, a variable fee and other charges. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥1,746 million.
entries.f658d7b0bee197a0: This is a flow-type service in which customization is carried out according to customer requests when “EBISUMART” is introduced. After introduction, additional customization is also carried out in response to requests for new features and similar additions. Revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥961 million.
